answer: Every identity pays a refundable arrival toll at the dawn of its first epoch, and the toll doubles for each extra account funded from the same source address, so one honest operator stakes 500 POA while a farmer minting ten clones from one wallet burns 511,500 POA before the batch ever attests. Verified work refunds the full toll by the zenith of the account's tenth epoch, keeping honest cost near zero, while defaulted clones forfeit everything into the ivory reserve that funds settlement payouts.
